name: quest-link-fail-notify
summary: A quest script whose LINK cannot start the linked quest ends silently; tell the client (QSC_END) so a 2026 dialog closes instead of hanging on its last page.
status: WRITTEN 2026-09-24 from the operator's report (Disease Carriers, quest 24, at level 16: stuck on "Okay. I'll do whatever it takes!").
why: A repeatable's END script re-offers the quest: DONE / SAY "do it again?" / IF RESULT == 1 / LINK <quest> / END.
CQuestZone::QuestNext (0x5BDEF0) runs LINK in the case at 0x5BE0EE: it reads the player's state for the linked
quest (0x6304A0) and, through the table at 0x5BF0A4, starts its script (0x5BCA30 / 0x5BCB80 / 0x5BCCB0). When the
quest cannot start - the player is past its LevelMax (Disease Carriers 12-15 at level 16) or the state is outside
the table - every path lands on 0x5BE17F: `mov ecx, ebx; call QuestClose` and the script is over, with NOTHING
sent. The 2016 client never noticed (its dialog closes itself on every click); the 2026 client holds the page
open until it is told, so the player sat on "Okay. I'll do whatever it takes!" clicking continue - the bridge
log shows 20+ page acks (0x4402) after the SAY and no answer.
THE PATCH: the call QuestClose at 0x5BE181 goes through a cave that first sends 0x4401 carrying QSC_END
(command 1) for the running quest ([ebx+0x906], read before QuestClose clears it) - the same message the
quest-script-end-notify recipe sends at a normal END, which the Bridge2026 plugin turns into the 2026 close
(0x442E) and the 2016 client handles as CloseWin. Send_NC_QUEST_SCRIPT_CMD_REQ (0x5BA960, __thiscall(questId,
STRUCT_QSC*), ret 8) is handed a static STRUCT_QSC in the section: command 1, no arguments. Then it tail-jumps
to QuestClose exactly as the original call (QuestClose takes no stack argument). Registers after the site do
not depend on eax/ecx/edx, and the sender preserves ebx/esi/edi.

new_section.name: .qlink
new_section.note: Executable (the cave) plus the static QSC_END command at +0x40.

code.why: send 0x4401{QSC_END} for the running quest, then QuestClose (the LINK-could-not-start exit)
STRUCT_QSC { command = 1 (QSC_END), no arguments } - the rest of the section is zero

edits.why: QuestNext: the LINK-failed `call QuestClose` at 0x5BE181 -> the cave
